title: Tirzepatide in Adults With Type 1 Diabetes: A Phase 2 Randomized Placebo-Controlled Clinical Trial
comparison_or_design: The primary tirzepatide trial comparison in adults with type 1 diabetes and obesity.
excluded: Weight-responder categories, basal/bolus insulin breakdowns and per-kg dose variants
Body composition, vascular/metabolic assays, other glycemic endpoints and safety
population_or_material: Adults with type 1 diabetes and obesity in the trial’s primary ITT weight analysis.
requested_items: Main Table 2 analysis baseline/week-12 values, arm changes and adjusted contrasts for weight, HbA1c and total insulin units/day; also explicitly reported weight-percentage difference and relative insulin percentage difference. Preserve ratio of geometric means as a ratio. Exclude Table 1 observational baseline descriptives and insulin subtypes/units-per-kg.
case_specific_rules: Use the published report for actual randomization, treatment received and efficacy analysis; distinguish any differing planned protocol populations or regimens. Retain directly reported weight-change confidence intervals literally.
